title: BorrowBox — Campus Equipment Library
intention: Help students find shared campus gear and see what is available before they walk to a pickup desk.
story: Fictional classroom demo. A student club needs a tripod and a presentation adapter for an event, but each campus desk keeps its own list. BorrowBox sketches a single catalogue with a pickup location and a loan status for every item.
current_work: A desktop catalogue mockup with five fictional items, their categories, pickup points, and availability. The original design has no search or filters.
pause_note: The catalogue layout was drafted before the semester ended. Search and filters are still open.
alt_text: BorrowBox catalogue showing five items with pickup points and loan status, before search and filters.
next_step: Design search and category filters, plus an Available now option. Show that Presentation and Available now together return two items.
attribution: BorrowBox is a fictional classroom exhibit. The original interface and all sample inventory were created for this demonstration.
